plan.title: Remove the deft-install gate mandate from the preamble surfaces (Phase 0)

narratives.Description: The DEFT-PREAMBLE in main.md line 2, the main-001 rule in the rules pack, content/templates/agent-prompt-preamble.md, the setup/sync skills, and CONTRIBUTING all currently mandate running the frozen gate before any other instruction. Under the settled deprecate-by-disuse decision (#1933 Option 1) that mandate is dropped and replaced with a cold-start fallback that points the operator at UPGRADING.md when deft or directive will not run.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
- Edit the main.md line 2 source file, content/templates/agent-prompt-preamble.md, the main-001 rule config in content/packs/rules/rules-pack-0.1.json, and the gate citations in the setup/sync skills and CONTRIBUTING.md so each one replaces the gate mandate with the 'if deft/directive does not run -> read UPGRADING.md' fallback.
- Refresh content/templates/agents-entry.md so no run bootstrap, run gate, or deft-install gate appears as a load-bearing operator path, then run task agents:refresh to regenerate the consumer AGENTS.md and task verify:encoding as evidence that no mojibake was introduced.
narratives.UserStory: As an agent reading the deft guidelines, I want the preamble to drop the frozen gate mandate, so that I follow the cold-start UPGRADING.md path instead of a deprecated Python gate probe.
